t: GVS Elipse P3 filters provide essential respiratory protection for trade professionals working in dusty environments. These high-efficiency synthetic particulate air filters offer over 99.95% filtration against hazardous fine dusts, including silica, asbestos, and wood. Ideal for construction, demolition, and woodworking tasks, the filters feature a protective grille to prevent large particles from puncturing the filter media, ensuring durability and consistent performance. The patented curved design of the Elipse model ensures a compact and comfortable fit, making it suitable for extended wear during demanding jobs where reliable dust filtration is paramount.
b: Patented Curved Design for Compact Fit
